title: market-pain.json
description: The buyer's pain, in the buyer's words, with evidence a stranger can click. Written by gtme-market-pain, read by gtme-icp (who feels it), gtme-offer (which problems earn components), gtme-write (which words to use) and gtme-measure (which pain hypotheses converted). Facts about the SELLER belong in company.json; targeting decisions belong in icp.json.

sources_swept.description: Source CLASSES actually swept, not individual URLs - those live in provenance.md. A class listed here that produced no citation is a claim of work that left no trace.

pains.description: Ranked by how loudly the pain is felt, not by how well the seller solves it.

pain.description: One sentence, in the buyer's framing. Vendor framing fails the review question.

felt_evidence.description: Why we believe it is FELT and not merely true - someone paying, hiring, or complaining about it.

workflow.description: How the day actually runs around this pain. Written so a practitioner would recognise their own week.

their_words.description: Verbatim buyer phrasing. Paraphrase here is the failure - these strings are what gtme-write reuses.

gap_math.description: What the pain costs, with the numbers cited. An uncited dollar figure here is the same failure as an uncited market stat: it survives internal review and dies in front of the buyer.

dream_outcome.description: Keyed by persona: what THAT role wants, in their language. gtme-offer reads this to build the value equation's numerator.

tried_and_failed.description: What the buyer already bought and resented. Every row is an objection waiting in a first call.

complaints.description: Named-vendor gripes at verbatim grain. A category-level disappointment averages four products into one sentence and loses the specifics that make displacement copy land - gtme-write quotes these, gtme-offer uses them for the incomparability question. Empty is legal when no named-vendor evidence was found.

verbatim.description: The complaint as written by the reviewer. Not your summary of it.

awareness.description: Per segment, how aware the buyer already is - which selects the copy register gtme-write opens in. A bare label here is an uncited assertion driving a real decision, so each carries its own evidence.

level.description: Schwartz's five. problem_aware buyers need the problem named; solution_aware buyers are already comparing vendors and need difference, not education.

pain_keywords.description: The buyer's search and complaint vocabulary. Feeds gtme-signals queries and gtme-write phrasing.

market_pain_stats.description: Category-level numbers usable in copy. Each carries the SCOPE it is true within, because a stat quoted outside its scope is how a defensible number becomes an indefensible one.

source.description: Who produced it. 'vendor-cluster consensus' is an honest answer; a laundered attribution is not.

market_verdict.description: The starving-crowd gate. gtme-icp blocks on do_not_run - a great ICP inside a dying market is a dead campaign.

note.description: One clause naming the binding constraint, when the four scores alone would mislead.

cites.description: Numbered references into this folder's provenance.md.
